about: plan-vector K6 (D7): RefRaster, the GPU's coverage rules emulated, in four variants against Android's Skia (SvgCanvas through K4's Frames: the port's layers at the case's density, no view-box fit, cropped), over G1's cases (plan-gpu D8). Structural: filters off on both sides, generator-only elements left out. Silhouettes: the same with mat drawn on both sides as the renders run it, so its coverage rule thins each variant's own coverage of its group (RefRaster's GroupFilter running the port's SvgFilterRaster); silhouetteMad is the MAD over the pixels hyb4's objects group covers in part (silhouetteShare of the frame); the classes at silhouettes take the cases whose renders draw mat ('mat': true; the named night draws none). Written by RefRasterCalibrationTest with -Datlas.calibrate=true.

variants.hyb4: G1's hyb4: 4x samples at the standard positions; FACE and ELL edges with analytic coverage at the pixel's centre, their opaque interiors at the samples; fills not cut into faces (STENCIL) at the samples; strokes up to 1 device px as Skia's hairlines, wider with their exact area
variants.msaa4-standard: 4x MSAA at Vulkan's standard 4x positions (0.375, 0.125), (0.875, 0.375), (0.125, 0.625), (0.625, 0.875): every area, and strokes, dots and rings from 2 device px (ribbons at world width), cover their samples; thinner strokes as hyb4 (configurations A and C)
variants.msaa2-standard: the same at Vulkan's standard 2x positions (0.75, 0.75), (0.25, 0.25) (configuration B)
variants.all-analytic: no MSAA: one sample, painter's order; FACEs and ELLs with analytic coverage, stencilled fills and clips by their area over an 8 x 8 grid; strokes as hyb4 (configuration D, FA)

decision.rule: D7: MSAA (msaa4-standard) stays unless its median MAD exceeds hyb4's by more than 0.15 in either class, structural or at silhouettes (else FA: analytic faces, as hyb4 draws them); all-analytic is taken only if it wins by a clear margin, its median more than 0.15 under the variant otherwise adopted in both classes and both modes. Medians over each class's cases.

configurationB.rule: D5.3: 2x (configuration B) where msaa2-standard is within 0.15 MAD of msaa4-standard in both classes; else configuration C (4x in ordinary memory)

gates.about: D16's final (A4) values from the adopted variant's structural numbers: a case's MAD + 0.10 + the lavapipe allowance 0.8, its within-2 share - 1 point - 2 points, its flat misses x 3; a class's values (for cases calibrated here by class only) from its p90 MAD, p10 within-2 and p90 flat misses (index floor(p (n - 1)) of the sorted values, as thresholds.json was first written); the sweeps' median gate the class's median MAD + 0.9, their p90 gate 1.0 above it (D16's spacing); a flat-miss gate never below 0.001 % (plan-gpu D8's structural gate), so a case measured with no flat miss at all does not get a gate of 0. 'adopted' is the calibration's architecture; another architecture's block (named as its os.arch reports it, e.g. amd64 on CI's x86 runners, when its numbers are recorded under 'arches') takes its own numbers for the cases it measured, and for each class the calibration's values moved by the median of what it measures differently there. A phone adds 0.4 MAD and takes 2 points of within-2 (thresholds.json's phoneRule).
